records.context: ``MemAvailable``, not ``MemFree``: free memory on a working machine is close to zero because the page cache holds the rest, and scheduling a trial against that number would refuse every trial on a healthy box. MemAvailable is the kernel's own estimate of what a new allocation could get without swapping.
records.label: spacr.parameter_sweep.free_memory_gb#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``MemAvailable``, not ``MemFree``: free memory on a working machine is close to zero because the page cache holds the rest, and scheduling a trial against that number would refuse every trial on a healthy box. MemAvailable is the kernel's own estimate of what a new allocation could get without swapping.
records.translation: ``MemAvailable``, no ``MemFree``: la memoria libre en una máquina en uso es casi cero porque la caché de páginas ocupa el resto, y planificar una prueba según ese número rechazaría todas las pruebas en un equipo sano. MemAvailable es la propia estimación del kernel de lo que podría obtener una nueva asignación sin recurrir al intercambio.

records.source: available memory in GB, or ``inf`` where neither source can be read. Infinity rather than zero deliberately -- this is a safety check, and a check that cannot read the machine must not become a check that blocks every run on it.
records.translation: memoria disponible en GB, o ``inf`` cuando no se puede leer ninguna de las dos fuentes.
